paragraph:
This is an automated hazard-exposure briefing produced by Riprap from live and baked data sources. It is informational only and not a substitute for a professional risk assessment.

**Answer.**
Three of the five NYCHA developments within 2,000 meters of 560 Grand Street, Manhattan, are mapped within the 2012 Hurricane Sandy inundation footprint [nycha_development_exposure]. Two of the five NYCHA developments within 2,000 meters of 560 Grand Street, Manhattan, are modeled to be inside the NYC DEP extreme stormwater scenario [nycha_development_exposure].

**Hazard Reader.**
The address is outside the empirical 2012 Hurricane Sandy inundation footprint [sandy_inundation]. The address sits in FEMA flood zone X, per NFHL FIRM panel 3604970203F, effective 2007 [fema_nfhl]. The address is outside the modeled flooding in the NYC DEP stormwater scenario [dep_moderate_2050].

**Out of scope.** This briefing does not assess title, structural condition, or compliance with specific zoning rules. Where a probe was offline at run time, the relevant section omits that signal.
